title: F07 — Resumable upload · TestFlight #1
tagline: files over 5 MB upload in 8 MiB parts and resume part by part after a kill, an expired URL or airplane mode; the first TestFlight build ships.

series.name: SiteLog: an iOS app and its API, built

intro: Sprint S4 · 47h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: files over 5 MB upload in 8 MiB parts and resume part by part after a kill, an expired URL or airplane mode; the first TestFlight build ships.
  • Demo — offline: 200 files queued in airplane mode, retry budget untouched; Wi-Fi only on cellular sends zero bytes.
  • Demo — signed in: 200 files / 2 GB finish with a kill in the middle; TestFlight installs on a real device.
  • Spec: 04.2, 04.5, 03-backend §7, 17 CI/CD
  • Starts from: F06. Domain, fake data, view models and the store are already built, so this feature starts at the contract and goes straight to the backend and transport.

sections.title: 5. Sync — Wi-Fi only, dedupe, URL refresh

blocks.html:
Overview

  • Goal: respect Wi-Fi only (default on), never upload the same bytes twice, refresh URLs before they expire.
  • Spec: 04.5
RuleWhere
allowsCellularAccess = false when Wi-Fi onlySession configuration
Same sha256 in a project → reuse remoteKeyCoordinator, before begin
URL near expiry → refresh firstPresignedURLProvider
  • Check: a 60 s URL TTL refreshes on its own; cellular with Wi-Fi only sends zero bytes.
blocks.text: Overview Goal: respect Wi-Fi only (default on), never upload the same bytes twice, refresh URLs before they expire. Spec: 04.5 Rule WhereallowsCellularAccess = false when Wi-Fi only Session configuration Same sha256 in a project → reuse remoteKey Coordinator, before begin URL near expiry → refresh first PresignedURLProvider Check: a 60 s URL TTL refreshes on its own; cellular with Wi-Fi only sends zero bytes. Diagram: job → hash already uploaded? → yes → reuse remoteKey → no → URL < 5 min left? → yes → refresh → PUT → no
